_note: The everyday items the app shows. The full price list stays on the phone; this only decides what is SHOWN (More > 'Show only everyday items'). Each item: [name, 'phrase|phrase', source, options]. source: list = from the owner's shopping list, note = from the owner's notes/screenshots, cat = a category made from the list so similar items are kept too, sug = suggested everyday item. options: x = words that rule an item out, b = brand words that also match, l = allowed sizes in litres [[min,max],...]. A phrase matches when all its words are in the product's own name (same rules as recipe matching, so 'milk' is not 'milk chocolate').
